releaseNotes: Tempest v1.6.2 (by J. Borden): Adds NEXRAD reflectivity ground-clutter & noise-speckle suppression with smooth linear raster resampling (CONUS Mosaic, N0B, N0Q via safe MapLibre v4 custom protocol while keeping Velocity/CC/ZDR raw), eliminates false iOS Safari / GitHub Pages OTA update loops via cache-revalidating app-shell fetches and strict versionCode gating, and expands automated Chromium verification.
